property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always returns true (call succeeds) regardless of whether external callee reverts or not; the mutant that reverts when an external call fails can cause transfer to revert (i.e. not return true) when a callee call fails, violating the universal return-true property.
change_summary: Insert a revert if any caddress.call returns false, causing the function to revert on failing external calls (detects callee failure).
